rationale: AI risk, which dominates level 4 and doom, is front-loaded: it tracks superintelligence arrival (most of which lands in the 2030s and 2040s) with a lag of a few years, so roughly half of the 2100 doom mass is reached by 2050. Wars, pandemics and civil breakdown strike at a roughly steady rate across the century, while climate and resource limits build slowly and push most of their level-3 contribution into the second half, which is why atLeast3 keeps rising steeply after 2050.
